Experience the full charm of Sushi Planet with this satisfying course! Start with a selection of six unique appetizers, including corn potage, sushi-style potato salad, and grilled oysters in oil. As you progress, enjoy new flavors with chawanmushi made with aosa seaweed, perfectly grilled salmon belly, and three types of freshly fried tempura. Indulge in six varieties of nigiri sushi featuring tuna, horse mackerel, and sea bream, and finish off with a luxurious hand roll of Wagyu beef and caviar! This course is perfect for those who want to fully enjoy both sushi and a la carte dishes, making it ideal for meals and banquets.

Enjoy a classic course at Sushi Planet that lets you savor everything from appetizers to tempura and sushi! Start with six types of appetizers, including oil-marinated oysters, duck loin, and tamagoyaki, followed by five varieties of freshly fried tempura. We also offer a diverse selection of six types of nigiri sushi, featuring tuna, horse mackerel, sea bream, boiled shrimp, toro-taku, and amberjack. This course is perfect for days when you want to enjoy a variety of snacks with a drink in hand or when you want to indulge in a full meal. Ideal for dining with friends or after-work gatherings!

Ultimate Course with All-You-Can-Drink: Featuring Wagyu Tenderloin Shabu-Shabu, Six Types of Sushi, and Freshly Fried Tempura! Sushi Planet Premium Course

Indulge in the premium course at Sushi Planet, featuring luxurious Wagyu Tenderloin Shabu-Shabu and sushi! Start with a vibrant selection of six appetizers, including corn potage, sushi-style potato salad, Ume Suisho, and oil-marinated oysters, followed by a delicate chawanmushi made with Aosa seaweed. The main course showcases tender Wagyu Tenderloin Shabu-Shabu, accompanied by three types of tempura and six varieties of nigiri sushi, including tuna, horse mackerel, and sea bream. To conclude, enjoy a playful Unatama Dog and Aosa miso soup. This course is perfect for special occasions when you want to savor both Wagyu and sushi!

[First Visit Limited, All-You-Can-Drink] Matsusaka Beef Feast Course JPY 8,500! A5 Matsusaka Beef cut by artisans, served with all-you-can-drink draft beer included!13 items

[1-minute walk from Suidobashi Station] Enjoy premium Matsusaka beef prepared in a variety of ways. Choose your preferred cuts—including rare parts you don’t usually get to try. Also enjoy popular items such as "Premium Lean Beef Yukke" (low-temperature cooked), "Seared Sushi of Matsusaka Beef Premium Loin with Caviar," and "Premium Fresh Beef Tongue." You can even savor "Premium Lean Beef Yaki-Suki" (grilled sukiyaki-style). Please enjoy a very satisfying 13-item course, generous in both portion and quality.

[Matsusaka Beef Introductory Course] JPY 5,000! A popular course to casually enjoy A5 Matsusaka Beef delivered directly from designated farms. Savor authentic Wagyu Yakiniku. *Draft Beer All-You-Can-Drink + JPY 1,50011 items

[1-minute walk from Suidobashi Station] Recommended for first-time visitors to Yakiniku Story! If you're not sure what to order, start with the Matsusaka Beef Introductory Course. We use Matsusaka beef delivered directly from a designated farm, and the course lets you casually enjoy popular dishes such as Seared Premium Matsusaka Loin Sushi and highest-grade Tongue Shabu-Shabu. A value-packed, highly satisfying course that captures the best of Yakiniku Story. Please take this opportunity to savor the exquisite flavor of Matsusaka beef.

Luxury Course with All-You-Can-Drink: Enjoy Six Types of Sushi, Tempura, and Wagyu Caviar Hand Rolls!

Experience the full charm of Sushi Planet with this satisfying course! Start with a selection of six unique appetizers, including corn potage, sushi-style potato salad, and grilled oysters in oil. As you progress, enjoy new flavors with chawanmushi made with aosa seaweed, perfectly grilled salmon belly, and three types of freshly fried tempura. Indulge in six varieties of nigiri sushi featuring tuna, horse mackerel, and sea bream, and finish off with a luxurious hand roll of Wagyu beef and caviar! This course is perfect for those who want to fully enjoy both sushi and a la carte dishes, making it ideal for meals and banquets.

Casual Enjoyment Course with All-You-Can-Drink: Five Types of Freshly Fried Tempura and Six Types of Sushi! Sushi Planet Party Course

Enjoy a classic course at Sushi Planet that lets you savor everything from appetizers to tempura and sushi! Start with six types of appetizers, including oil-marinated oysters, duck loin, and tamagoyaki, followed by five varieties of freshly fried tempura. We also offer a diverse selection of six types of nigiri sushi, featuring tuna, horse mackerel, sea bream, boiled shrimp, toro-taku, and amberjack. This course is perfect for days when you want to enjoy a variety of snacks with a drink in hand or when you want to indulge in a full meal. Ideal for dining with friends or after-work gatherings!

Ultimate Course with All-You-Can-Drink: Featuring Wagyu Tenderloin Shabu-Shabu, Six Types of Sushi, and Freshly Fried Tempura! Sushi Planet Premium Course

Indulge in the premium course at Sushi Planet, featuring luxurious Wagyu Tenderloin Shabu-Shabu and sushi! Start with a vibrant selection of six appetizers, including corn potage, sushi-style potato salad, Ume Suisho, and oil-marinated oysters, followed by a delicate chawanmushi made with Aosa seaweed. The main course showcases tender Wagyu Tenderloin Shabu-Shabu, accompanied by three types of tempura and six varieties of nigiri sushi, including tuna, horse mackerel, and sea bream. To conclude, enjoy a playful Unatama Dog and Aosa miso soup. This course is perfect for special occasions when you want to savor both Wagyu and sushi!

[9/19–10/31] Halloween Afternoon Tea
It’s a 2-hour café freestyle session where you can choose from 14 varieties of drinks, including teas from the brand “Mighty Leaf”. Enjoy an elegant tea time while watching the changing seasons in the rooftop garden through the windows.

---------------------------------

• The spacious interior features floor-to-ceiling glass windows offering lush greenery—a soothing setting that makes you forget you’re in the city center. Relish your afternoon tea in this cool and comfortable café.
• There are around 30 seats available. The tranquil atmosphere and attentive service ensure a truly relaxing experience.
• Each season brings a new theme, with 10 savory and sweet items made using seasonal ingredients.
• Unwind with the delightful aromas of “Mighty Leaf” teas. With the café freestyle format, help yourself to as much as you like!
---------------------------------

Mousse of autumn eggplants, pear, and scallop tartare

[9/19–10/31] Halloween Afternoon Tea
It’s a 2-hour café freestyle session where you can choose from 14 varieties of drinks, including teas from the brand “Mighty Leaf”. Enjoy an elegant tea time while watching the changing seasons in the rooftop garden through the windows.

---------------------------------

• The spacious interior features floor-to-ceiling glass windows offering lush greenery—a soothing setting that makes you forget you’re in the city center. Relish your afternoon tea in this cool and comfortable café.
• There are around 30 seats available. The tranquil atmosphere and attentive service ensure a truly relaxing experience.
• Each season brings a new theme, with 10 savory and sweet items made using seasonal ingredients.
• Unwind with the delightful aromas of “Mighty Leaf” teas. With the café freestyle format, help yourself to as much as you like!
